questions.question: Which specimen or diagnostic finding belongs in a reference record for Artifacts and non-parasitic mimics?
options: A parasite-specific infective larva produced by the artifact's life cycle.
Background objects in stool, blood films or other preparations; record the actual specimen matrix.
A obligatory mosquito stage shared by all artifacts.
Adult artifact worms releasing eggs in human bile ducts.
questions.explanation: Background objects in stool, blood films or other preparations; record the actual specimen matrix. Review focal planes, stain, calibrated size and surrounding context; seek coherent diagnostic anatomy rather than a single color or outline.
